description:
Applies a machine learning model to a data cube of input features and returns the predicted values.

Before inference, the data cube is checked against the input specification of the model (``mlm:input``). The process fails if a dimension named in ``dim_order`` is missing, if a dimension is shorter than the model input requires, or if a band required by the model is missing and cannot be computed. If the result returned by the model does not match the shape or data type declared in ``mlm:output``, the process fails instead of reshaping the result.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data cube containing the input features.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A ML model that was trained.

returns.description: A data cube with the predicted values. The dimensions holding the input features of the model are removed and a new dimension for the predicted values is added. It has the name `predictions` and is of type `other`. If a single value is returned, the dimension has a single label with name `0`.

ModelInputDimensionMissing.message: The dimension '{dimension}' required by the model input (`mlm:input`) is missing in the data cube.

ModelInputDimensionTooShort.message: The dimension '{dimension}' has {size} labels, but the model input (`mlm:input`) requires {required}.

ModelInputBandMissing.message: The band '{band}' required by the model input (`mlm:input`) is missing in the data cube.

ModelOutputMismatch.message: The model output does not match the shape or data type declared in `mlm:output`: {reason}
